facts.fact: 三天应酬下来只想回家找 Bailey 和 Flora
facts.anchor: all I want is to go home to Bailey and Flora.

facts.fact: 她 Boxing Day 起偏头痛——十几岁以来第一次三天
facts.anchor: She’s had a migraine since Boxing Day. Her first three-dayer since she was a teenager.

facts.fact: 她语音坚持让他留下谈未来——他想立刻飞回去照顾她
facts.anchor: in her voice notes that she sent between naps she insisted I stay for my future.

facts.fact: 对她父母的愤怒：他们不配做她父母
facts.anchor: I’d like to tell her parents they don’t deserve her as a daughter.

facts.fact: 老队友 Pluto：Vipers 取消了家庭滑冰——浪费时间（对比 Chasers 的 Halloween special）
facts.anchor: We’re dropping the family skate. Coach said it’s a waste of time.

facts.fact: 传言：Coach 想赛季中签他——可能提前回美国
facts.anchor: Monster Max might be coming home earlier than planned.

facts.fact: 五天都熬不住——两年怎么办？她可能遇到同龄人、不想被异地带走的人拖累
facts.anchor: I can’t even cope with five days without her. How will I cope for two years?

facts.fact: 结尾：那地方可能很快也不再是「我的家」
facts.anchor: Only it might not be my home for much longer.
